Tapestry crochet's firm fabric suits bag: Kitambaa thabiti cha crochet ya tapestry kinafaa mifuko na mifuko ambayo lazima ishikilie umbo lake.

Start with 6 stitches in a magic ring. O: Anza na mishono 6 kwenye pete ya kichawi. Kwa kila ongezeko la pande zote, ongeza stitches 6, ueneze sawasawa.
